thread:
olivia (Marketing): Heads-up: Nimbus marketplace co-marketing kickoff. They want a short playbook + a joint webinar and a marketplace feature tile. Targeting mid-July launch. Who can own the playbook?
ben (Partnerships): I can coordinate partnership approvals and Nimbus asset exchange. Need a clear timeline from marketing. Also ask Nimbus for any benchmark claims they want included.
ruth (Growth): For inbound routing, Nimbus sends leads to our webhook. Recommend we map region -> SDR queue and add lead.source_detail = 'nimbus_marketplace_tile'. Also set cookie-based UTMs when users click through from Nimbus.
jon (Content): I'll lead the playbook and the webinar story. Idea: 20-minute "Real-world cost & latency tradeoffs" segment + 10-min demo. Want to avoid percent claims in the hero; we'll use relative language and cite the appendix.
amar (Sales Eng): I'll produce a benchmarking summary: two configs — Redwood hosted on Nimbus infra vs upstream default Nimbus image. Will capture avg latency, p95, tokens/sec, and cost_per_1k. Will run 10 trials per config.
frank (Ops): Ops notes: marketplace product tile needs a one-line blurb (max 160 chars), a 600x400 PNG, and an iframe for the quickstart. Who's producing that?
olivia (Marketing): @jon + @frank collaborate on the tile copy + assets. Draft hero copy options: "Lower inference unit cost on Nimbus with Redwood" vs "Predictable latency for production inference". Prefer safer language: "Deliver predictable latency and lower unit cost with Redwood on Nimbus."
ruth (Growth): Small ask on lead routing: set lifecycle_stage=marketing_lead, source=nimbus_marketplace, assign to owner based on continent. We'll need a mock payload to test the mapping.
webhookbot (Integration Bot): Please include sample JSON when creating the mapping. Typical payload fields: email, company, company_size, region, plan_interest, referral_code.
ben (Partnerships): Nimbus wants joint assets and a co-registration landing page. They prefer the registration be on their site (for marketplace UX). We need to ensure the pixel/webhook flows back to our HubSpot. Any privacy concerns?
frank (Ops): We'll need a signed DPIA and a data processing addendum. Can Partnerships get that from Nimbus legal?
ben (Partnerships): I'll request it.
jon (Content): Webinar promotion plan: (1) Nimbus email to their marketplace list, (2) Redwood social + newsletter, (3) 2 week paid LinkedIn boost. Landing page will gate the benchmark appendix.
olivia (Marketing): CTA on Nimbus tile should be "Register for benchmark webinar" linking to Nimbus landing (with our UTM params). Also create a short lead magnet (one-page PDF) summarizing methodology.
amar (Sales Eng): Bench methodology: synthetic mix of prompt lengths and steady-state batching. I'll include variance and CI. Expect to submit CSV + methodology by Thu.
frank (Ops): For HubSpot mapping: hubspot.endpoint = /integrations/marketplace/nimbus. We'll map plan_interest -> lifecycle_stage_rules. Also ensure we tag leads with campaign=nimbus_co-marketing_jul2025.
ruth (Growth): Lead scoring: if demo_requested=true OR company_size>50 AND intent>=6 then MQL. Also set up an automation to create a task for SDR with script + qualifying questions.
onj (Content): Small edit: Can we angle one of the webinar takeaways to "how to pick the right quantization/instance combo" to drive product interest?
amar (Sales Eng): Good idea — I can include a short tradeoff matrix in the slides.
ben (Partnerships): Nimbus asked if we'd co-write a short blog post after the webinar summarizing the findings. @jon can you draft that and share with Nimbus for joint approval?
jon (Content): Yup. I'll draft webinar deck + blog sketch by Monday.
olivia (Marketing): Ops check: once webhook is live, schedule end-to-end test Thurs 11am PT. @webhookbot will validate schema.
webhookbot (Integration Bot): A test webhook payload posted to #marketing-tests at 1732594139. Schema validated.
frank (Ops): Quick legal note: avoid absolute "X% cheaper" headlines in marketplace tile — use "reduces unit cost" and link to appendix.
ben (Partnerships): Nimbus will provide a draft copy for localized emails. We'll share our version for co-approval by next Wed.
olivia (Marketing): Owners recap: Playbook + webinar story: @jon. Bench: @amar. Webhook/HUBS mapping + test: @frank. Partnership/legal coordination: @ben. Landing page + assets: @jon/@frank. Draft dates: bench Thu, draft deck Mon, assets Tues, landing up Wed. Any blockers?
ruth (Growth): All good from Growth side.
jon (Content): I'll post drafts to #marketing-drafts and slack you all.
olivia (Marketing): Thanks team, will follow up with a milestone calendar. :rocket:
